mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% over the past 3 months signals an easing cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% in one month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing corporate investment and consumer confidence, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate creates a dual signal: monetary easing offsets labor market stress, reducing risk premiums and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS <4.5% and UNRATE >4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) in a supply-driven expansion regime reduces production bottlenecks and lowers input costs, fostering corporate profitability and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when INDPRO > 105 in supply-driven expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in quarterly GDP below 23700 signals a contraction in economic activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and investor confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 < 23700.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant growth in economic demand (GDPC1 rising) and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS falling) create a dual expansion signal, lowering interest rates on debt and boosting equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 >23500 and FEDFUNDS <4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 signals weakening supply chains and reduced manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 100 in supply contraction regime.
